newsitem.title: ST VINCENT: CRICKET-WINDIES WIPE OFF ARREARS -- BUT RAIN RETURNS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WINDIES WIPE OFF ARREARS -- BUT RAIN RETURNS.

text.p: West Indies wiped off their first innings deficit as they reached 124 for two by lunch on the third day of the second test against Sri Lanka on Sunday.
It gave West Indies an overall lead of 49 but then heavy rain, which also disrupted play on Saturday, returned during the interval to delay a prompt restart in the afternoon.
Resuming at their overnight score of 19 without loss, West Indies lost the wickets of openers Sherwin Campbell (33) and Stuart Williams (46) while adding 105 in the morning session.
At the interval, Brian Lara was unbeaten on 27 and Floyd Reifer 14.
But when the afternoon session was due to start, pools of water lay on many parts of the ground and there was some doubt whether any more play would be possible.
